verified.description: A United States-based company that designs, builds, and deploys data centers in space using proprietary technology. In November 2025, the company launched Starcloud-1, equipped with an NVIDIA H100 GPU, to explore how orbital conditions could support large-scale computing in space.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as 'Lumen Orbit' in El Segundo, California in January 2024, then relocated to Redmond, Washington in February 2024. Rebranded to Starcloud in March 2025 after legal challenge from Lumen Technologies. Series A funding announced March 30, 2026. Wikipedia indicates fastest YC unicorn (17 months post-program completion). Sources [3] and [4] appear to be news articles but lack sufficient detail for verification of specific claims.
